launch.startup_check: healthy through step 325: all reported losses and gradients finite, full-image MSE fell from 0.46670 at step 1 to 0.11495, and post-compile throughput was about 3,200 images/s
launch.orchestration: the tokenizer holds one lifetime gpu-claim; both prior services wait without a GPU claim for the tokenizer cache and codec-health marker, then independently enter the shared queue

hypothesis: Learned registers that participate from the first encoder block can form a better distributed whole-image representation than a terminal read, and a one-quarter-strength image-spectral log-SNR ordering can let early register groups become soft conditioning context without the exposure and optimization costs of the previously tested full-strength schedule.

tokenizer.name: v34-inputreg-e8-det-jitter05-slotbal2e3-n64d16-s2
tokenizer.formation: 64 learned registers are concatenated with 64 non-overlapping 4x4 patch embeddings before encoder block 1 and participate in all eight bidirectional blocks
tokenizer.positions: patch tokens retain learned 2D positions and 2D RoPE; register identities are learned truncated-normal vectors and receive identity rotary transforms
tokenizer.output: retain the register slice, apply the parameter-matching register adapter, normalize, and project each register from width 512 to 16 channels
tokenizer.parameter_control: exactly equal to v27 residual pooling and the earlier deterministic formation arms
tokenizer.objective: full-image pixel MSE plus scale-invariant sample-varying slot-power balance at weight 0.002

controls.late_register_note: v13/v25 inserted learned registers only for one terminal joint block; they are historical late-register controls, not tests of the present full-depth input-register design

soft25.name: v34-inputreg-e8-det-jitter05-slotbal2e3-n64d16-s2-prior-softsnr25-s1
soft25.time: endpoint-preserving rational path with tokenwise time conditioning
soft25.formula: effective crossing = sigmoid(0.25 * logit(CIFAR anchor)); rational scale = (1-crossing)/crossing
soft25.ordering: native learned register index with no post-hoc permutation
soft25.clean_magnitude: unchanged; both arms use the same tensor-wide population mean and standard deviation

selection.reconstruction_role: permissive codec-health veto only: manually review only if PSNR is below 28 dB together with clean reconstruction FID above 25, or if outputs/statistics are non-finite or visibly corrupted
selection.architecture_comparison: common-time v34 versus selected v27 at the same tokenizer/prior seeds
selection.schedule_comparison: soft25 versus common time on the exact same v34 cache
selection.advance_5k_to_10k: advance an arm when its relevant FID improves, lies within 2 points, or FID/KID disagree; run both 5k priors regardless of the common arm's architecture result so the exact-cache schedule effect remains identifiable
selection.architecture_replication: full-depth common time must improve v27 by at least 2 FID at 10k with lower KID before tokenizer seeds 1 and 3
selection.combined_replication: soft25 must improve its v34 common control and v27 by at least 2 FID at 10k with lower KID before tokenizer seeds 1 and 3
selection.negative_result: a concordant FID loss greater than 2 at 5k stops that comparison

cleanup_policy: tag and debloat only after this final screen so its required code and checkpoints are not removed mid-campaign
